what.text: This page follows refugees from Myanmar living in Macao SAR, China, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 1972, the only year with a figure, UNHCR counted 5000 refugees from Myanmar in Macao SAR, China, 87.7% of all refugees from Myanmar that year.
Today, Bangladesh hosts the most refugees from Myanmar, followed by Malaysia, Thailand and India.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflicts in Myanmar over the government and over Karen and Kachin territory, active in 1972 and in many years since.
The fact pack does not say why people went to Macao SAR, China.

when.text: UNHCR's data has a figure for this group for 1972 only.
So the data shows no change over time for this group.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Macao SAR, China.
This is a year-end total for Macao SAR, China only, reported to UNHCR for 1972.
